description: Pedestal-mounted Marut, identity D1227 established from photo album; has worn light blue, red-white Surya Kiran style and later silver schemes. Source WoI (updated Feb 2026), BR.
Harvard on pedestal near the auditorium, no serial survives; formerly yellow, repainted red-white. Source WoI.
Erected 2013, one of the first Deepak gate guards after the 2009 grounding. Source WoI.
